visualCharacteristics: Split banner: image + heading, copy and 1-2 CTAs side by side; image side follows authored row order. Default: light background with rounded contained image and dark text. dark: solid dark background, image bleeds to the block edge, white text.
contentPattern: 2 rows: media row (image) and content row (optional logo image, h2, p, optional em note, 1-2 CTA links); the first row renders on the left
